name: eft_scalar_r12
description: Round 24, the proposed repair of the Casimir-EFT note: the heat enters the nonlinear equation as the companion's energy density heard from all around (the law's scalar S), L = -|grad phi|^3/(12 pi G a) + S |grad phi|/(4 pi G) - rho phi, i.e. div[(|grad phi|/a - S/|grad phi|) grad phi] = -div F, with F the cold companion's flux (the law's memory). Spherical tests: identical to the law (two-way S). Collision maps: code/eft_field_v24.py mode 'eft_scalar' (the field along F, the curl field neglected). Strong-field hold kept. Registered comparison, not adopted.
